decision.rules: §2.6: S1, S1n or S2 better than C3 by >= 5 % on vertex or direction, clear, MLP and attentive probes of the same sign, and no worse than the best of C1, C2, C3 on the primary outcome (seed-mean sealed vertex error <= the best dense seed mean).
decision.verdict: report and stop: the sparse family is a negative result on WCTE (no S arm passes the rule)
